# Contributing

## Workflow

All work follows:

Issue → Branch → Commit → Pull Request → Merge

---

## Branch Naming

Examples:

```txt
feat/10-responsive-navbar
experiment/11-css-grid-lab
docs/12-update-roadmap
chore/13-update-tooling
```

---

## Commit Convention

Examples:

```txt
feat: add responsive navbar
experiment: build css grid playground
docs: update architecture guide
chore: configure prettier
```

---

## Pull Requests

Every pull request should:

- reference an issue
- include a summary
- pass lint checks
- follow naming conventions
- update documentation where necessary
